= Scatter =

"""Scatters new points across a surface."""

The Scatter SOP generates points on the surface of the input geometry.

@parameters

== Generation ==

Force Total Count:
    #id: usemaxpts
    Use an exact number of output points.

See also [Node:sop/scatter] for the current node.
